a6.statement: A check is in logic exactly when a one-loop plan earns it with the items held; the fill places an unchecked in-logic check whenever the game is not waiting on another world, so every loop not waiting can earn one.

omsi.name: Idle Loops (omsi-loops)
omsi.note: action names, town-0 structure and the numbers the rules below scale

an-omsi-d.note: omsi-loops town 0 (Beginnersville) mapped to 20 nodes by the AN-OMSI-D design: time = ceil(omsi level-0 mana / 20) with a 100-mana loop; each item +10 starting mana; multipart actions are one performance per segment; a stated limit is kept, a growing limit flattened (Smash Pots 3, Pick Locks 2, Short Quest 2, Long Quest 2), an unstated one capped at 3 (Haggle 2), progress actions 1; gold / 10; every-Nth rewards given every time. The first step of each progress bar (Wander, Met, Secrets) is `after` (done this loop); later steps are boost items. Combat + Magic >= 35 is Combat 2 and Magic 2: a Training item gives +1 every loop, a Lesson +1 within the loop. Every action except the start and the goal is a check (18), with 10 Soulstones as filler. Trained stats (Str, Dex, ...), talents, skill exp and story texts are not modelled.

approved.ruling: Q1-Q6 as recommended (the town numbers; commit the preset)

left-out.note: LEFT OUT of town 0 (six omsi actions): Open Rift (Dark and Spatiomancy, later-town skills); AssassinZ0 (Assassin, a town-7 skill); SurveyZ0, Hitch Ride and Map (explore progress, whose first map comes from town 7's Explorers Guild); Found Glasses (never startable, a display row). Also dropped: the glasses' Wander x4 (Wander progress is a boost here), Throw Party's Met +3200 (nothing after the party reads Met), Small Dungeon's soulstones and the multiparts' skill exp, and the segments' rising cost curve.

buy-supplies-6.note: Buy Supplies costs 6 gold, not omsi's 300 / 10 = 30: one loop holds at most 12 gold with every item, and the goal is refused at 10

haggle-folded.note: Haggle's -20 gold on Buy Supplies' price is folded into Gold +2 per Haggle (the same for the one purchase a loop makes)
